content: Ananya Nair inquires about the policy reinstatement timeline and total due amount. Sunita Agarwal informs her that she has 30 days from expiry to pay, and the total amount due is ₹15,500 (₹14,000 premium plus ₹1,500 reinstatement fee). Sunita also offers to resend the invoice.

action_items: Agent to resend the invoice if requested by the customer
